questions.text: A circle centered at the origin is tangent to the parabola \(y^2=8x\). Find the radius of the circle.
An ellipse centered at the origin has vertices \((\pm 10,0)\). A point \(P\) on the ellipse is such that its distances to the two foci are \(6\) and \(14\). Find the coordinates of \(P\).

questions.text: Point $P$ lies on the hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{25} - \frac{y^2}{144} = 1$. If $F_1$ and $F_2$ are the foci of the hyperbola and the angle $\angle F_1 P F_2$ is exactly $90^\circ$, determine the area of $\triangle F_1 P F_2$.
